meta: Video 100 of the channel opens up the backstage, hosted by Mark (asking for you) and robot Bit (explaining). Every video is made by AI together with one person.

muc.title: Special episode #100
muc.text: This is a special episode: video number 100 of the channel. Mark wonders: how is all of this made? Bit answers: let's open up the backstage. Every video is made by AI together with one person.

muc.title: It starts with a prompt
muc.text: Everything starts with a prompt, which is just a message. Claude writes the script and splits it into scenes, one idea per scene. But nothing happens next until the person running the channel approves the script.

muc.title: A person picks the logo
muc.text: Same with the logo. Claude drew 9 designs, and the person running the channel picked one: an M made from the letters A and I. Then it changed to sky blue, also someone's choice.

muc.title: An AI voice
muc.text: The voice you're hearing is an AI voice from ElevenLabs. There were 8 male voices to try, and this one was chosen. The whole script is read in one go, then cut into sentences, so the voice doesn't change halfway.

muc.title: Drawing with code
muc.text: The pictures aren't filmed. Claude writes code that makes the computer draw each frame, 30 frames per second, matched to each spoken sentence. Then it exports two versions: vertical for phones, horizontal for YouTube.

muc.title: A whole team of Claudes
muc.text: And it's not just one Claude. One Claude coordinates, and each series gets its own Claude, all working in parallel. That's multi-agent. When they're done, another AI listens back to every sentence with speech-to-text to catch misread words.

muc.title: The logo got covered
muc.text: And it isn't always right the first time. Once, the phone's on-screen buttons covered the logo. The person running the channel sent back a screenshot, Claude fixed it, and since then every video stays inside the safe area.

muc.title: Posting through Metricool
muc.text: Finished videos go into Google Drive. Claude grabs the links, writes titles and descriptions, then schedules everything in Metricool: 5 short videos a day for YouTube, TikTok and Facebook, plus one long video that combines a whole series.

muc.title: AI does the work, you decide
muc.text: The lesson here: let AI do the heavy lifting, and keep the decisions for yourself. Try it with your own work: ask AI for a first draft, and you just review and give feedback.
